mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, bio, level, experience, role, mentor_enabled, openid, province, city, district, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{bio}, #{level}, #{experience}, #{role}, COALESCE(#{mentorEnabled}, 0), #{openid}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user ORDER BY experience DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) as totalDays FROM user u LEFT JOIN checkin c ON u.id = c.user_id AND c.status = 'approved' GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level ORDER BY totalDays DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) as totalDays, COALESCE(streak_data.streakDays, 0) as streakDays FROM user u LEFT JOIN checkin c ON u.id = c.user_id AND c.status = 'approved' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as streakDays FROM ( SELECT user_id, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY date DESC) as rn FROM checkin WHERE status = 'approved' AND date <= #{today} GROUP BY user_id, date ) consecutive_dates WHERE DATEDIFF(#{today}, date) = rn - 1 GROUP BY user_id ) streak_data ON u.id = streak_data.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, streak_data.streakDays ORDER BY totalDays DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM user u INNER JOIN goal g ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE g.type = #{goalType} AND u.id != #{excludeUserId} LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM user ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id != #{excludeUserId} ORDER BY experience DESC
SELECT type FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id != #{excludeUserId} AND (phone = #{keyword} OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY experience DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET level = #{level}, experience = #{experience}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET mentor_enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: WITH approved_dates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id, date FROM checkin WHERE status = 'approved' AND date <= CURDATE() ), ranked_dates AS ( SELECT user_id, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn, MAX(date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS latest_date FROM approved_dates ), activity_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedDays, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 30, 1) AS checkinRate, SUM(CASE WHEN latest_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATEDIFF(latest_date, date) = rn - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS streak FROM ranked_dates GROUP BY user_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(a.approvedDays, 0) AS approvedDays, COALESCE(a.checkinRate, 0) AS checkinRate, COALESCE(a.streak, 0) AS streak FROM user u LEFT JOIN activity_stats a ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, u.province, u.city, u.district, u.mentor_enabled AS mentorEnabled, COALESCE(a.approvedDays, 0) AS approvedDays, COALESCE(a.checkinRate, 0) AS checkinRate, COALESCE(a.streak, 0) AS streak, GREATEST(3 - COALESCE(slots.occupied, 0), 0) AS remainingSlots FROM user u LEFT JOIN activity_stats a ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT partner_id, COUNT(*) AS occupied FROM partner WHERE match_mode = 'lead' AND status IN ('pending', 'accepted') GROUP BY partner_id ) slots ON slots.partner_id = u.id WHERE u.id != #{excludeUserId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partner p WHERE ((p.user_id = #{excludeUserId} AND p.partner_id = u.id) OR (p.partner_id = #{excludeUserId} AND p.user_id = u.id)) AND p.status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'blocked') )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM goal g WHERE g.user_id = u.id AND g.status = 'active' AND g.type IN #{type} )
AND (u.phone = #{keyword} OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.mentor_enabled = 1 AND a.approvedDays >= 24 AND a.checkinRate >= 80 AND a.streak >= 7 AND a.checkinRate > #{requesterRate} AND COALESCE(slots.occupied, 0) < 3
ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.province = #{province} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
COALESCE(a.checkinRate, 0) DESC, ABS(COALESCE(a.checkinRate, 0) - #{requesterRate}),
u.id LIMIT 60
